implementation.scope: Completed deployed evaluation images; repeatable RGB measurements; complete attributed optional evaluator responses; descriptive calibration against direct inspection.

test_limits: Full 1,380-test source and initial-wheel regressions began before the final semantic-rubric binding fix. Final source focused run passed 89. Final-wheel focused run passed 88 with one retained fixture-server WinError 10053/stderr failure during the short timeout case; all four unmodified recovery variants passed on rerun. All 46 final image-check tests passed in both implementations. No timeout/assertion was relaxed. Fixtures do not prove model/evaluator quality.

retained_failures.cause: The canonical fixture writer rejected an intentionally malformed float before the code-under-test ran. Fixed only malformed-input serialization; 45 checks passed.

rubrics.constant_frame: Fail: the entire RGB image is one solid color. Pass: visible variation.
rubrics.edge_bands: Fail: visible straight border bars along the outer image edges. Pass: no such bars. Uncertain: background, snow or another scene surface may be a bar. Unavailable: no distinguishable interior. Inset frames and internal panel dividers are outside this rubric. Intent and general image quality are not inferred.

value.method: Fixed artifact-screen definition before measuring the 72 natural images. No threshold fitting or searching. All C-01 baseline images were previously exposed; this is descriptive calibration, not a held-out accuracy claim.

value.limitations: Assistant observations, not ground truth. C-01 images and prior notes were exposed before this review; no blinding, independent rater, held-out evaluator validation or population error estimate. Raster display and semantic ambiguity limit judgments. Six visible outer frames and one uncertain snow/border example retained. No threshold or training change from these labels.

policy.limitations: Twelve hand-authored prompts are broader targeted SDXL still-life coverage, not statistical population coverage. Exact normalized caption exclusion cannot prove semantic or pretraining independence. Counts/material/layout require direct inspection with uncertain allowed. Strength and no-trigger expectations are frozen now but base-only results cannot measure adapter behavior. ComfyUI dpmpp_2m/karras, CFG 7, 20 steps, 512px differs from the retained Diffusers diagnostics; same seeds do not establish sampler parity.
policy.method: Preregister all twelve prompts and thirty-six case/seed pairs. Freeze before baseline generation or any new tuning. Inspect both base conditions at all seeds. Later compare both adapter conditions at 0.25, 0.5 and 1.0 against the matched base controls; record all failures and uncertainty without ranking by loss or pixel differences. Legacy cases are exposed diagnostics. New holdouts are excluded from training captions, data selection and hyperparameter tuning; baseline inspection is declared exposure, not a claim of a hidden test set. Use only diagnostic regressions for C-04 development. If a holdout informs tuning, declare contamination in a new additive corpus and add fresh holdouts while preserving every old case and seed.

value.limits: Artifact screens have narrow rubrics, fixed disclosed parameters and no composite score. Their passes cannot accept semantic or model quality. Reference labels are observations, not ground truth; calibration on exposed examples is descriptive, not independent validation. Missing judgments remain unavailable. Imported evaluators are recorded assertions, not verified execution or calibrated confidence. No promotion is authorized.

rubrics.constant_frame: Fail: the entire RGB image is one solid color. Pass: visible variation.
rubrics.edge_bands: Fail: visible straight border bars along the outer image edges. Pass: no such bars. Uncertain: background, snow or another scene surface may be a bar. Unavailable: no distinguishable interior. Inset frames and internal panel dividers are outside this rubric. Intent and general image quality are not inferred.
rubrics.image_quality: Inspect coherence, intact geometry and composition, unintended repetition or divided panels, materials and rendering defects. Pass only for observable coherent quality, fail a visible defect, retain ambiguity as uncertain. Unavailable means no inspection. A technically valid PNG or metric pass does not establish this verdict.
rubrics.prompt_adherence: Compare this image with its exact prompt, negative prompt and case expectation. Check every required object, count, attribute, spatial relation and exclusion. Pass only when all are observable and satisfied. Fail an observable contradiction. Use uncertain for ambiguous/hidden requirements and unavailable if unable to inspect.

visual_inspection.method: C-02 assistant directly inspected all 72 original 512px tiles in the twelve C-01 lossless contact sheets before seeing new image-check measurements. Newly annotated constant-frame and outer-band rubrics. Semantic references retain every C-01 verdict and note unchanged.
visual_inspection.limitations: Assistant observations, not ground truth. C-01 images and prior notes were exposed before this review; no blinding, independent rater, held-out evaluator validation or population error estimate. Raster display and semantic ambiguity limit judgments. Six visible outer frames and one uncertain snow/border example retained. No threshold or training change from these labels.
